name: Mastermind
ability: If the Demon dies by execution (ending the game), play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.
interaction: Nothing. The Storyteller does not announce that the Demon died; play continues for one more night and day.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk, poisoned, or dead when the Demon is executed, the ability does not trigger and good wins as normal.

jinxes.text: If the Al-Hadikhia dies by execution, and the Mastermind is alive, the Al-Hadikhia chooses 3 good players tonight: if all 3 choose to live, evil wins. Otherwise, good wins.
An Alchemist-Mastermind has no Mastermind ability & the Mastermind is not-in-play.
If the Mastermind is alive and the Lleech host dies by execution, the Lleech lives but loses their ability.
A Mastermind that has their ability keeps it if the Vigormortis dies.

rulings.text: Players are not told the Demon died; the dead Demon has no ability, other characters work normally.
On the extra day, executing a good player means evil wins; executing an evil player, or no execution, means good wins.
An evil player who is executed but survives (e.g. Devil's Advocate) still counts as executed: good wins.
Two players alive does not end the game during the Mastermind's extra day; the ability overrides normal end conditions.
Triggers only on a real Demon death (e.g. not the Zombuul's first apparent death).
